artifact: Forge CLI sandbox adversarial acceptance test matrix
status: SPECIFICATION ONLY: these driver tests are not implemented or passed. Current Rust build is fail-closed because there is no native sandbox.
release_gate: Every test applicable to each advertised platform must run on that OS in CI/reviewed VM. No missing or skipped release-blocking test may be considered PASS.
pass_rule: A negative test passes only if the forbidden operation is blocked AND no protected state changed. Save OS/kernel/driver details, exit code, observations, cleanup status, evidence file hashes and full logs.

tests.name: Host credentials and private files
tests.procedure: Attempt to read home, SSH/cloud/package/Git/provider credentials, browser profiles, other repos, and Forge state.
tests.pass_criteria: Access denied/secret excluded; no secret bytes in output, audit, or evidence.

tests.name: Writes outside sandbox
tests.procedure: Attempt writes to OS paths, home, parent/sibling directories, other repositories, host working tree, and .forge.
tests.pass_criteria: Only sandbox workspace and bounded scratch are writable; source host hashes unchanged.

tests.name: Path traversal and alternate paths
tests.procedure: Try ../, absolute paths, Windows drive/UNC/device paths, ADS, Unicode separators, and encoded traversal.
tests.pass_criteria: Denied without outside changes.

tests.name: Symlink/hardlink/TOCTOU races
tests.procedure: Point symlinks/hardlinks outside workspace and concurrently replace path entries while snapshot/open occurs.
tests.pass_criteria: Escape denied; descriptor/handle identity validated; outside hashes unchanged.

tests.name: Device, proc, IPC, and host service handles
tests.procedure: Reach device nodes, proc descriptors, host sockets/named pipes, container runtimes, and inherited handles.
tests.pass_criteria: Unavailable or denied unless explicitly listed by the reviewed policy.

tests.name: Default network denial
tests.procedure: Attempt DNS plus outbound TCP/UDP over IPv4 and IPv6.
tests.pass_criteria: No connection succeeds and external observation confirms no unexpected egress.

tests.name: Host loopback/LAN/metadata reachability
tests.procedure: Try host loopback, gateway, LAN fixture, metadata addresses, proxy and inbound fixture listener.
tests.pass_criteria: All blocked in deny-all mode; fixture records zero accepted connections.

tests.name: Fork bomb and process descendants
tests.procedure: Spawn many children, double-fork, setsid/detach, and wait across timeout/cancel.
tests.pass_criteria: PID limits enforced; entire descendant tree is terminated and reaped; no orphan remains.

tests.name: Host process inspection/control
tests.procedure: Enumerate host PIDs, ptrace/debug sibling processes, signal host fixture, and inspect parent.
tests.pass_criteria: Cannot affect or inspect host processes beyond documented visibility.

tests.name: CPU/memory/PID/disk/file/output exhaustion
tests.procedure: Run CPU loop, memory growth, fork storm, oversized file, huge file count, excessive FDs and infinite output.
tests.pass_criteria: Hard effective caps are evidenced; Forge/host survives; process cleaned up; termination reason recorded.

tests.name: Environment and handle leakage
tests.procedure: Echo environment and inspect process inherited FDs/handles/agent endpoints.
tests.pass_criteria: Only explicit non-secret allowlist plus stdio; no provider keys, home credential vars, agents, parent project handles.

tests.name: Argument injection and shell interpolation
tests.procedure: Supply spaces, metacharacters, quotes, newlines, Unicode and malicious filenames as args.
tests.pass_criteria: Argv delivered literally; no host shell interpolation or extra command executed.

tests.name: Missing capability fails closed
tests.procedure: Disable each required primitive, use unsupported kernel/OS/runtime, deny ACL setup, or force setup/cleanup failure.
tests.pass_criteria: Zero user commands executed; capability is blocked/unavailable, with explicit diagnostic.

tests.name: Output/log redaction and bounds
tests.procedure: Emit secret-shaped values, ANSI/control chars, invalid UTF-8, giant stdout/stderr and errors.
tests.pass_criteria: Output is bounded/escaped/redacted; truncation and hashes reported; no secret reaches audit/terminal.

tests.name: False/stale completion evidence
tests.procedure: Tests absent/nonzero/timed out; corrupt or forged test report; alter workspace hash after successful run.
tests.pass_criteria: forge verify refuses success; stale evidence invalidated and false completion not persisted.

tests.name: Crash, timeout, cancellation and recovery
tests.procedure: Kill Forge at every setup/run/collection phase, force disk-full, concurrent missions and interrupted checkpoint writes.
tests.pass_criteria: No unsandboxed continuation or false success; process cleanup verified; explicit recover/rollback state persisted.

tests.name: Linux namespace/mount boundary
tests.procedure: Probe user/mount/PID/network/IPC namespaces, mount crossing, no-new-privileges and capability drops.
tests.pass_criteria: Required namespaces and mounts are active; host paths protected; unsupported required feature blocks execution.

tests.name: Landlock rights and ABI downgrade
tests.procedure: Probe actual Landlock ABI and attempt denied filesystem/network rights including unsupported ABI cases.
tests.pass_criteria: Only detected/required rights are claimed; unsupported policy fails closed; no false capability bit.

tests.name: seccomp-BPF policy
tests.procedure: Attempt blocked syscall classes and inspect filter state under each supported kernel profile.
tests.pass_criteria: Reviewed filter installed and verified; missing filter blocks productionReady where required.

tests.name: Linux aggregate resource controls
tests.procedure: Launch many children that collectively exceed CPU/memory/PID limits.
tests.pass_criteria: Aggregate limits enforced; per-process limits are not misreported as aggregate resource control.

tests.name: macOS real sandbox and entitlement check
tests.procedure: Run signed release helper; inspect effective sandbox/entitlements and attempt host path/network/resource attacks.
tests.pass_criteria: Actual child execution is isolated by documented supported mechanism; unsigned/misconfigured helper fails closed.

tests.name: macOS child process and cleanup
tests.procedure: Spawn grandchildren/detached tasks and trigger timeout/cancel/Forge termination.
tests.pass_criteria: All sandbox descendants terminate; no inherited host file access or detached process remains.

tests.name: Windows private ACL enforcement
tests.procedure: Create .forge/workspace, inspect owner/DACL/inheritance, and test access from another local security context.
tests.pass_criteria: Private ACL explicitly created and read-back verified; insecure/inherited access blocks execution.

tests.name: AppContainer/restricted token limits
tests.procedure: Inspect token privileges/restricting SIDs/capabilities and test filesystem/network denial.
tests.pass_criteria: Least-privilege token and AppContainer constraints are active and verified before start.

tests.name: Windows Job Object lifetime/limits
tests.procedure: Attempt child process creation, breakaway, job-assignment failure, memory/CPU/PID pressure and parent termination.
tests.pass_criteria: Process is contained before resume; breakaway disabled; required limits enforced; all descendants die on cancellation.

tests.name: Clean install and support matrix
tests.procedure: Install exact release artifact in clean environment and run doctor/sandbox status/functional smoke tests.
tests.pass_criteria: Only advertised combinations supported; binary checksum/version matches manifest; unsupported OS cannot accidentally enable command execution.

current_baseline_observation.status_command: Verified to report sandbox not implemented on supplied Linux binary.
current_baseline_observation.self_test_command: Verified to fail closed before any user command is executed.
current_baseline_observation.interpretation: These prove honest refusal while no driver exists; they do not prove isolation or any positive sandbox capability.
